verdict.rationale: Benchmark's API lets an agent set up a campaign's name, subject, sender and recipient list, or duplicate a prior campaign, and the docs say the user then opens it in Benchmark to make final edits and send. That amounts to a draft-then-human-send flow. Targeting is by list rather than an explicit segment, and there is no documented scheduling, queueing or formal approval state. Missing for 10: API targeting of segments (not just lists), documented scheduled/queued or pending-approval campaign states, any API-based content/body authoring, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can draft a campaign against a segment and leave it scheduled or queued for a human to approve before send

citations.quote: Set up the campaign name, subject line, sender details, and recipient list via the API.
Duplicate a previous campaign via the API to inherit its design, then open it in Benchmark to make final edits and send.
